req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 requires that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We must verify this for all body-returning endpoints (GET /players/, GET /players/{id}, GET /players/squadnumber/{n}, POST /players/) and confirm that no-body endpoints (PUT 204, DELETE 204) are excluded from the requirement. Tests cover: positive EP (GET all returns application/json), positive EP (GET by id returns application/json), positive EP (GET by squad number returns application/json), positive EP (POST 201 returns application/json), boundary BVA (Content-Type header value contains exactly 'application/json' not a superset/subset), negative NEG (404 error response still carries application/json), and DT covering the matrix of endpoints x content-type presence.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
expected: Response body is a non-empty JSON array
trace: R-PLAYER-026: GET /players/ returns body => must have application/json Content-Type
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json()

tests.name: test_all_get_endpoints_return_application_json_content_type
expected: All three GET endpoints return HTTP 200
None of the Content-Type headers are empty or non-JSON
trace: R-PLAYER-026: All /players/* endpoints returning a body must use application/json
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_all_get_endpoints_return_application_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    endpoints = [
        '/players/',
        '/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802',
        '/players/squadnumber/1',
    ]
    for url in endpoints:
        r = client.get(url)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 for {url}, got {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
        assert 'application/json' in ct, f'Expected application/json for {url}, got {ct}'
        assert ct != '', f'Content-Type must not be empty for {url}'

test_all_get_endpoints_return_application_json_content_type()
